newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak in Cairo after Tunisia, Libya visit.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak in Cairo after Tunisia, Libya visit.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak returned home to Cairo on Tuesday after visits to Libya and Tunisia, airport officials said.

Mubarak held brief talks with Tunisian President Zine el-Abidine Ben Ali during an unscheduled visit to Tunis, at which the two leaders condemned European plans to set up a military force serving the southern Mediterranean basin.
The Egyptian president left Cairo for Libya on Monday where he held talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.
